patronOf.en-US: Bishop of Ravenna, Doctor of the Church
patronOf.pt-BR: Bispo de Ravena, doutor da Igreja

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant, through his intercession, that we may constantly ponder in our hearts the mysteries of your salvation.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos, por suas preces, meditar sempre no coração os mistérios da salvação.

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a broad, rounded, full face — a wide, smooth forehead with a receding hairline, a short, straight nose with a rounded tip, kind dark eyes set wide apart and creased at the corners, full, rounded cheeks, a broad, full-lipped mouth slightly open as if speaking, a soft, round chin; thin, short grey hair and a short, round-trimmed grey beard, and a warm, eloquent look.
meta.basis: His contemporary mosaic portrait in San Giovanni Evangelista, Ravenna, is lost; the later engraved portraits show a balding bishop with a short beard, which the card follows. The golden chasuble alludes to his name, 'golden-worded'.
